WITH transaction_trader AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
), counts AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM transaction_trader
  GROUP BY tradekind
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS overall_total
  FROM counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(overall_total, 0)) AS average_share
FROM counts
CROSS JOIN totals
GROUP BY tradekind;
